## Type

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] chore — tooling / build / deps
- [ ] breaking — includes breaking changes

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Added/updated tests or verified manually
- [ ] Updated relevant `skills/tavily/references/*.md` if a command's flags/behavior changed
- [ ] Updated [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) under `[Unreleased]` (if user-facing)
